details_hint: Agent rows get a second line: model, context, idle time, folder. The session header always shows the model and a context bar. Off by default.
as_used_hint: Context shows how much is used (39% used) instead of how much is left (61% left); turns to a warning colour from 80%. Off by default.
hint_ok: Context is how much of this conversation the agent can keep in mind. When it runs out, it compacts on its own: earlier parts are kept only as a summary.
hint_warn: Almost full. When it fills up it compacts on its own and earlier parts are kept only as a summary. To wrap up first, send /compact to compact now, or start a new agent to carry on.
